title: AI Badge Photo Maker
summary: Free AI badge photo maker: turn a casual photo or selfie into a clean ID badge headshot with a plain background, even light and a straight on pose.
body_markdown:
### Is there a free AI badge photo maker?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6, which made every badge photo on this page, costs 5 credits an edit.


### How do I make an ID badge photo from a selfie?


Add the selfie to an image edit model and ask for a plain background, soft even front light, a straight on pose and a chest up crop, and ask it to remove the wide angle stretch of a front camera while keeping your face the same.


### What background is best for a badge photo?


A plain, evenly lit white, light grey or pale blue background is the usual choice for work and campus badges, but use the colour your organisation asks for so every card in the set matches.


### Can I use an AI badge photo for a passport or government ID?


Check with the office that issues it first. Passports and government IDs follow their own official photo rules for size, background and editing, so use the photo they ask for rather than an AI edit.


### Can AI change my clothes in a badge photo?


Yes. Describe the clothes you want, such as a navy blazer over a white shirt, or ask it to keep the ones you have on; the face and hair stay the same when the prompt says so.


### Will the badge photo still look like me?


Mostly. The model redraws the whole picture, so small details such as freckles or the shape of glasses can change; name them in the prompt and compare a few versions with your original photo.
